categories.main_business_segments: Bozhon Precision Industry Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent manufacturing equipment, focusing on automation equipment, flexible production lines, key automation components, and tooling fixtures. The company serves multiple sectors including consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, semiconductor manufacturing, automotive electronics, instrument and meter manufacturing, and smart warehousing logistics. It also provides integrated intelligent factory solutions and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies such as high-precision placement, high-precision welding, machine vision systems, precision motion control, servo algorithms, laser welding, and advanced automation control systems. It develops modular, flexible, and intelligent automation lines, including vacuum potting, laser cutting, and integrated assembly lines. The firm also invests heavily in R&D for semiconductor packaging equipment, lithium battery manufacturing equipment, and intelligent charging and swapping stations, employing advanced manufacturing methods like modular design, AI-driven vision inspection, and precision robotics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Bozhon's key customers include globally renowned consumer electronics manufacturers such as Apple and major players in new energy vehicles like CATL and Tesla. The company also serves semiconductor manufacturers, automotive parts suppliers, and smart logistics providers. Its products are widely used in manufacturing smartphones, tablets, TWS earbuds, smartwatches, AR/MR/VR devices, lithium batteries, electric vehicles, and semiconductor packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wujiang Economic and Technological Development Zone. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore, Japan, the United States, India, Vietnam, and Hungary, focusing on markets in Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America. Overseas revenue accounts for approximately 42.82% of total revenue, reflecting significant international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bozhon operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain as a manufacturer and integrator of automation equipment and key components. It supplies automation solutions and equipment to manufacturers in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, and semiconductor industries, enabling production and assembly processes. The company also produces core components like linear motors, servo drives, and industrial robots, positioning itself upstream in key technology areas.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in automation technology, focusing on high-precision assembly, flexible modular production lines, AI integration, and intelligent manufacturing systems. It actively develops new products for emerging sectors such as semiconductor advanced packaging, lithium battery manufacturing, intelligent charging and swapping stations, and smart logistics. Bozhon invests over 10% of its revenue in R&D, maintains a large engineering team, and pursues breakthroughs in core technologies like machine vision, laser welding, and robotics control algorithms.
categories.revenue_model: Bozhon generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized automation equipment, tooling fixtures, and core components. It engages in project-based contracts with major manufacturers, providing end-to-end solutions including design, production, installation, and after-sales services. The company also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bozhon is positioned as a leading domestic intelligent manufacturing equipment provider in China, competing with international giants like Siemens, ABB, FANUC, and KUKA in high-end automation markets. It holds a strong market share in consumer electronics automation and is rapidly expanding in new energy vehicle and semiconductor sectors. The company is recognized as a national champion in specialized manufacturing equipment and is advancing toward global competitiveness through technology innovation and international expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Bozhon achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.95 billion, representing a 2.36% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 398 million, up 2.05%. The company maintains a stable gross margin around 34.37% and invests over 10% of revenue in R&D. Total assets reached RMB 8.9 billion, growing 13.74% from the previous year. The firm has a workforce of over 6,000 employees, including nearly 2,000 in R&D, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bozhon emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive customization services to deliver high-precision, flexible, and intelligent automation solutions. Its products feature modular design, high automation levels, and integration of AI and machine vision, enabling clients to improve production efficiency, reduce labor costs, and enhance product quality. The company’s deep industry expertise and stable partnerships with leading global manufacturers underpin its competitive advantage and ability to rapidly respond to evolving market demands.
